title.original: MCP-Universe: Benchmarking Large Language Models with Real-World Model Context Protocol Servers
title.zh: MCP-Universe：使用真实世界模型上下文协议服务器对大型语言模型进行基准测试
title.en: MCP-Universe: Benchmarking Large Language Models with Real-World Model Context Protocol Servers

inclusion_reason.zh: MCP-Universe 交付真实 Server 适配、长时程 Runner 和静态/动态执行评测器，可扩展到新 Agent 与工具。
inclusion_reason.en: MCP-Universe delivers real-server adapters, a long-horizon runner, and static/dynamic execution evaluators extensible to new agents and tools.

abstract.zh: MCP-Universe 让 LLM 与真实 MCP Server 交互完成六类长时程任务，并以静态、动态和格式执行器核验真实世界结果。
abstract.en: MCP-Universe makes LLMs interact with real MCP servers on six long-horizon domains and verifies outcomes with format, static, and dynamic execution-based evaluators.

problem.zh: 简化工具基准无法覆盖不熟悉 Server、长交互导致的上下文膨胀，以及时间敏感结果需要实时真值的评测难题。
problem.en: Simplified tool benchmarks omit unfamiliar servers, context growth over long interactions, and the need for live ground truth on time-sensitive outcomes.

approach.zh: 基准接入跨导航、仓库、金融、3D、浏览器和搜索的真实 Server，并按任务类型选择格式、静态内容或实时真值评测器。
approach.en: Real servers span navigation, repositories, finance, 3D design, browser automation, and search, with format, static-content, or live-ground-truth evaluators per task.

system_design.zh: 可扩展框架提供 Server 适配、Agent Runner、交互/上下文记录、三类执行评测器和 UI，允许新增 Agent 与 Server。
system_design.en: An extensible framework provides server adapters, an agent runner, interaction/context logging, three evaluator classes, and a UI for adding agents and servers.

key_results.zh: 先进模型和企业 Agent 在真实 Server 上仍表现有限，主要受到长上下文增长和不熟悉工具语义的双重挑战。
key_results.en: Advanced models and enterprise agents remain limited on real servers, with interaction-driven context growth and unfamiliar tool semantics emerging as dual challenges.

limitations.zh: 只覆盖少数 Server 和六个域，实时评测会受外部 API 变化影响；凭据、成本和副作用也限制完全可复现性。
limitations.en: Coverage is limited to a small server set and six domains, live evaluation changes with external APIs, and credentials, cost, and side effects constrain reproducibility.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
